name: PT Surya Toto Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Surya Toto Indonesia Tbk manufactures and sells sanitary, fittings, kitchen systems, and other related products in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through the Sanitary, Fittings, Kitchen systems, and Electrical Appliances and Accessories segments. The company offers neorest; washlet; toilet, lavatory, urinal, bidet, bathtub, sink; automatic, shower and bath, shower spray, faucet, and accessories, such as robe hook, floor drain, door handle, shelf, and tumbler holder; and supplementary parts, including stop valve and flexible hose.
